fusions.name: Atoll Rising
fusions.desc: Raises a ring of reef around you that deals 26 damage, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each one [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Passing Current
fusions.desc: Sends a current at the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lagoon Ring
fusions.desc: Grows a ring of reef where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Accreted Bands
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 the stacks all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 5% of your maximum health per stack (29% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
